description: This PHP file defines the DetailedLeave class within the OrangeHRM Leave plugin, representing detailed information about a leave request, including methods to retrieve leave status, balance, periods, allowed actions, and workflows.
external_methods: OrangeHRM\Entity rom Leave: getDate, getDecorator, getStatus, getLengthDays, getEmployee, getLeaveType

classes.name: DetailedLeave
classes.description: Represents detailed information about a leave request, providing access to leave status, balance, periods, allowed actions, and workflows, encapsulating leave-related data and behaviors.

methods.name: getLeave
methods.description: Returns the Leave object associated with this detailed leave.

methods.name: setLeave
methods.description: Sets the Leave object for this detailed leave and resets cached properties.

methods.name: setLeaves
methods.description: Sets multiple Leave objects, representing a collection of leaves.

methods.name: getLeaves
methods.description: Retrieves the collection of leaves associated with this detail.

methods.name: getDatesDetail
methods.description: Returns details about the leave request dates, including duration type and times.

methods.name: getLeaveStatus
methods.description: Returns the status of the leave, including name and length, encapsulated in LeaveStatusWithLengthDays.

methods.name: getLeaveBalance
methods.description: Calculates and returns the leave balance for the employee, leave type, and period.

methods.name: getLeavePeriod
methods.description: Determines and returns the leave period based on the leave date and type.

methods.name: getAllowedActions
methods.description: Returns the list of actions permitted for this leave request, considering the current leave status.

methods.name: getAllowedWorkflows
methods.description: Fetches the allowed workflow state machines based on the leave status.

methods.name: isActionAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a specific action (approve, reject, cancel) is permitted on the leave request.

methods.name: getWorkflowForAction
methods.description: Retrieves the workflow state machine corresponding to a specific action.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets cached properties related to leave details.
